title: feat(nmoaxis): outgoing-axis agreement at t+1 on #7167: reverse HOLD, face fails
science: Outgoing-axis agreement: Axis(O)(A)=Axis(O)(B)={e_2,e_3} but Axis(O)(C)={e_1,e_3} != Axis(O)(D)={e_1}, so hold/fail. Its runner proves the useful bridge lemma lx_m == axis_o at all four probes, i.e. on this cell the leftover of Axis(M) IS Axis(O) -- another statement of the axis partition.
